paper.title_en: Cosmological structure formation in ultralight dark matter
paper.abstract_en: An important challenge in cosmology is to describe the formation of galaxies and structures, starting from small inhomogeneities in the early Universe, which later grew and formed the so- called dark matter halos. We consider the dark matter to be composed of ultralight bosons and simplify the general complex problem of halo formation by using the time-dependent variational analysis approach. This yields, for the first time, a fully analytical equation for the time-evolution of perturbations towards isolated haloes. We follow the evolution of the halo size and density during different stages of its formation, revealing the role of the background density, Universe expansion, and quantum pressure.
